label: prop:vol-through-tau
title: $\mathrm{Vol}(K)$ factors strictly through the fibre functor $\tau$
html:
Proposition. \mathrm{Vol}(K) factors strictly through the fibre functor \tau

Proposition (conditional on conj:kashaev-volume-conjecture). Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a QOU with fibre functor \tau. For every braid \beta \in B_n, with image \rho(\beta) \in H_n(R, q) and closure K_\beta, the real-valued knot volume \mathrm{Vol}(K_\beta) factors strictly through \tau:

Quantifier corrected 2026-08-25 (PR #5765). This read "for every braid \beta \in H_n(R,q)" — which conflates a braid (an element of B_n, which has a closure) with a general Hecke element (an element of H_n(R,q), which does not). \rho : B_n \to H_n(R,q) is neither injective nor surjective, and the statement is only meaningful on its image.

This is not pedantry: the production binding pipeline evaluates \mathrm{tr}_M on atom_braid_word_3A, whose letters are c\,\sigma_g + d\,\mathbf{1} — general Hecke elements, not braid generators. Read with the old quantifier, this proposition appeared to license a volume for that object. It does not, and the corresponding \mathrm{Vol} is in fact 0 (2026-08-25-atom-word-closures-are-not-hyperbolic.md).

  \mathrm{Vol}(K_\beta)
  \;=\;
  \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\bigl(\mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta)\bigr)
  \;=\;
  (\pi_\infty \circ \tau)\bigl(\mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta)\bigr).

There is no other archimedean route.

Identification. On the algebraic quantum volume, \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} coincides with \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{top}} = \pi_\infty \circ \chi_{\mathrm{top}}. The fibre functor \tau is the exclusive bridge to the laboratory continuum. The realization functor defines its canonical computation rule.

Sketch (conditional). The conjectural hypothesis is the Kashaev volume conjecture: the hyperbolic volume of the closure equals the Kashaev limit of the colored Jones polynomial (conj:kashaev-volume-conjecture, Lean class VolumeConjecture, field kvc_holds). By Tannaka-Krein rigidity, any composite mapping \mathbf{C} to \mathbb{R} that preserves tensor products and dualities is uniquely isomorphic to the fibre functor \tau; the realization functor's computation rule evaluates \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} on the algebraic quantum volume \mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta) as exactly the Kashaev limit. Conditional on the conjecture, the two identifications compose to \mathrm{Vol}(K_\beta) = \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}(\mathrm{Vol}_q(\beta)) — this composition is the Lean-derived step (vol_through_tau_of_volumeConjecture), with the Kashaev identification consumed as the class hypothesis rather than asserted.
